# HaDay HebRabbAi Mentor

Biblical Hebrew vocabulary trainer for first-year students.

Public pages:
- https://hebrewmentor.haday.app/
- https://hebrewmentor.haday.app/legal
- https://hebrewmentor.haday.app/credits
- https://hebrewmentor.haday.app/how-to-memorize-biblical-hebrew-vocabulary

The class study, games, listen pages, and lexicon require sign-in. Textbook pages and answer keys are not published here.
